name: beon-edit
description: Tim's editing system for Beon Media concept videos in DaVinci Resolve: mandatory opening grilling and job card, Footage Prep first, shot log, footage sort, A-roll cutting, B-roll rulebook, a QA manager agent that checks every stage (with a second-look verifier), colour grading, per-client subtitles (Fluid Reveal Words), finishing and the learn-from-Tim loop.
